_comment: Unsigned source of truth for the golden set (PROTOCOL.md §10). Edit this, then run `bun scripts/sign-golden.ts` with the offline root key to produce golden.json. Real entries carry the SEV-SNP launch MEASUREMENT (hex48) of the published runner image for that runner_version plus its dm-verity root; none exist until the image pipeline lands (runner/image/). Simulated entries use the convention measurement = SHA384("gpubnb-simulated-" || runner_version) — the Rust simulated attester and makeSimulatedDoc() both produce exactly that, so a simulated runner of a listed version verifies as status "simulated" and nothing else.
